stockHint: What you hold, where it is, and what is running low.
movementsHint: Every change to stock, newest first.
adjustmentsHint: Correct stock after damage, loss or a found item. Each one needs a reason.
transfersHint: Move stock between your shops and stores.
countsHint: Count what is on the shelf and fix the differences.
locationsHint: The places you keep stock: shops, warehouses and stock on the road.
noStockHint: Record opening stock for a location, or receive goods from a supplier.
lowStockHint: Products whose stock, across all locations, is at or under the reorder level.
setLevelsLink: Set reorder levels on each product.
allGoodHint: Products with a reorder level appear here when stock falls to it.
productsLow: product(s) at or under their reorder level
noStockOfProduct: No stock of this product yet.
noStockOfProductHint: It appears here once it is received or counted in.
noMovementsHint: Every sale, receipt, adjustment and transfer shows up here.
codeHint: A short code, for example MAIN.
name: Name

kindHints.store: A shop floor or counter that sells stock.
kindHints.warehouse: A place that keeps stock for supplying shops.
kindHints.transit: Holds stock while it moves between places.
kindHints.virtual: A book location with no building, for example consignment.

noLocationsHint: Add the shop or warehouse where you keep stock.
openingHint: Enter the stock a location already held when you started using the system. Do this once for each product and location.
asAtHint: The date the quantities were true.
openingCostHint: Enter what each unit cost you ({{currency}}). Cost drives your stock value.
openingAsk: Post opening stock for {{count}} product(s)? It cannot be changed afterwards; correct it later with an adjustment.
duplicateProduct: A product appears more than once. Put its quantity on one line.
noAdjustmentsHint: Use an adjustment to write off damaged goods or correct a wrong quantity.
draftNote: This is a draft. Stock does not change until you submit it.
submitAdjustmentAsk: Submit this adjustment? If it needs no approval it posts now and stock changes.
sentForApproval: Sent for approval. Stock changes once an approver accepts it.
waitingApproval: Waiting for an approver to accept it. Stock has not changed yet.
rejectedNote: This was rejected. Stock did not change. Write a new one if it is still needed.
noTransfersHint: Create a transfer to move stock from one location to another.
transferDraftNote: This is a draft. Stock leaves the source only when you send it.
transferOnTheWay: The stock is on its way. Receive it when it arrives.
dispatchAsk: Send this stock now? It leaves the source location and is held in transit until received.
receiveHint: Check the quantity that arrived. Where it differs from what was sent, choose a reason.
noCountsHint: Start a count to compare the shelf with the books.
startCountHint: This records what the system holds now. Then you enter what you find on the shelf.
countingNote: Enter what is on the shelf for each line, then save. Finish counting when done.
finishAsk: Finish counting and review the differences?
uncountedAsZero: Treat the {{count}} uncounted line(s) as zero on the shelf
reviewNote: Give a reason for each difference, then submit. Stock is corrected when it posts.
reviewNoDifferences: No differences. Submit to close the count.
submitCountAsk: Submit this count? Differences are posted to stock, or sent for approval if they are large.
cancelCountAsk: Abandon this count? Nothing will change in stock.
noLocationYet: There is no store or warehouse yet, so stock cannot be recorded.
